# Breathizen

> Breathizen (label spelling: BreathiZen) is a dietary supplement oral spray made to support easy breathing. This is an independent affiliate landing page, not the manufacturer; orders are completed on the official Breathizen website. Last updated 2026-11-11.

## What Breathizen is

- Format: liquid oral spray in an amber glass pump bottle
- Serving: 4 pumps (0.60 mL) once a day, ideally in the morning before the first meal; shake well first
- Ingredients: mullein leaf extract (10:1), ginger root extract, bromelain, organic lemon extract, organic Cordyceps militaris fruiting body extract
- Made in the USA in an FDA-registered facility, according to the manufacturer
- Per-serving ingredient amounts are not published, and there is no published clinical trial of the finished product
- It is a dietary supplement, not a medicine, and does not replace inhalers or prescribed treatment

- One-time purchase, no subscription
- 60-day money-back guarantee from the purchase date; the manufacturer's wording asks for at least 30 days of use before a refund request

## Who should ask a doctor first

People who are pregnant, nursing or under 18; anyone with asthma, COPD or high blood pressure; anyone taking blood thinners or other regular medication; anyone allergic to pineapple.
